title: Cover shared reroll, same-turn exemptions and observed source movement
outcome: Cover shared reroll, same-turn exemptions and observed source movement
acceptance: Behavioral tests show a shared changed report at the same identity does not enable a reroll, a different identity does, and an accounted unadmitted shared change remains qualifying evidence.
Behavioral tests show a passing same-source shared check after the cut is exempt through the same-turn rule while failed or other-source checks are not.

Behavioral tests for an observed shared check show a later different source moves it, a return to the original complete identity leaves it standing, and shared change records do not become an unrevised legacy change.
